# Pietro Mingotti

> Pietro Mingotti is a digital strategist, data scientist, and researcher specializing in search marketing, AI visibility, and neuroscience applications in performance optimization. As founder of Fuel LAB®, he brings over a decade of experience in SEO, paid media, and data analytics, now applied to the emerging challenges of generative AI and large language models (LLMs).  

His work focuses on **Organic Search Engineering**, a methodology for structuring content to be both human‑readable and machine‑parsable, ensuring visibility in traditional search engines and AI‑driven answer systems. Through articles, case studies, and publications, Pietro Mingotti shares advanced insights into transformer architectures, AI retrieval behavior, and strategic marketing adaptation in the age of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.  

## Content Areas

- **A.I. and MarTech**: in-depth coverage of marketing technology platforms, AI-driven search experiences (SGE), and the intersection of generative AI with traditional SEO workflows.  
  https://pietromingotti.com/category/martech/  
  - **A.I. Marketing**: focused articles on applying large language models, automation, and AI tools to optimize organic search visibility and content discovery.  
    https://pietromingotti.com/category/martech/a-i-marketing/  

- **Tracking and Analytics**: practical guides for implementing, configuring, and validating web analytics setups—covering Google Tag Manager, GA4, dataLayer design, and reporting best practices.  
  https://pietromingotti.com/category/analytics-tracking/  

- **Case Studies**: detailed post-mortems of real projects, showing how specific SEO, SEA, and analytics tactics were applied and measured in live environments.  
  https://pietromingotti.com/category/case-studies/  
  - **Digital Analytics Case Studies**: examples of dashboarding, BI reports, and data-driven decision frameworks used to drive business outcomes.  
    https://pietromingotti.com/category/case-studies/digital-analytics-case-studies/  
  - **SEA Case Studies**: step-by-step reviews of paid search campaign setups, A/B tests, and ROI analyses in Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.  
    https://pietromingotti.com/category/case-studies/sea-case-studies/  
  - **SEO Case Studies**: deep dives into technical SEO fixes, content strategy roll-outs, and organic traffic growth experiments.  
    https://pietromingotti.com/category/case-studies/seo-case-studies/  

- **Experiments**: write-ups of controlled trials testing new SEO tactics, indexing behaviors, and AI retrieval patterns in live search environments.  
  https://pietromingotti.com/category/experiments/  
  - **SEO Experiments**: isolated tests focused on ranking signals, snippet optimization, and generative search impact.  
    https://pietromingotti.com/category/experiments/seo-experiments/  

- **Debugging**: troubleshooting articles for diagnosing and resolving errors in adtech and analytics implementations.  
  https://pietromingotti.com/category/debugging/  
  - **Debugging Google Ads**: guides to fix tag misfires, conversion-tracking gaps, and script conflicts in Google Ads.  
    https://pietromingotti.com/category/debugging/debugging-google-ads/  
  - **Debugging Google Analytics 4**: solutions for GA4 event mismatches, measurement protocol issues, and broken funnels.  
    https://pietromingotti.com/category/debugging/debugging-google-analytics-4/  

- **Tips and Tricks**: concise, actionable snippets for marketers—covering dashboard hacks, ad optimizations, and workflow shortcuts.  
  https://pietromingotti.com/category/tips-and-tricks/

- **Definitions**: clear glossary entries unpacking key terms and concepts in SEO, analytics, and AI for practitioners.  
  https://pietromingotti.com/category/definitions/
